elevation_source: NASA/USGS SRTM 1 arc-second HGT via AWS Terrain Tiles (N26E094)

simulation.rainfall_input: raw spatial rainfall field in mm/hour
simulation.infiltration_input: scenario-constant loss in mm/hour, applied as max(rainfall - loss, 0); not a Green-Ampt model
simulation.boundary: reflective on all sides; no river inflow or outflow is represented

sequence_learning.input: Recent state sequence [h, hu, hv], raw rainfall, infiltration loss, DEM, and Manning n.
sequence_learning.split_policy: Complete rainfall-pattern groups are assigned to a single split; time frames from one scenario are never separated.
sequence_learning.initial_state: ANUGA rasterized state at t=0; equal to state_sequence[:, 0].

accuracy_note: Mass balance checks numerical conservation only. Rainfall, initial states, infiltration, and parameter combinations are synthetic; no observed flood depths or river levels were used.
